answer: Quorum-weighted slashing with rotation: every scoring round uses a randomly sampled jury of established agents, and each juror posts a bond forfeited on collusion. A sybil cluster must win two lotteries at once: place clones in the jury sample AND keep every colluding juror from being outvoted by bonded honest peers. The onyx-hard deposit scales with jury size; the forge of repeated graded epochs tempers an identity faster than any bribery budget; a fresh clone emits no beacon of trust until it has paid and passed many rounds. Attack cost grows quadratically, honest cost stays linear.
